The '''Migrant Merchants' Guild''' was a supposedly legitimate [[Merchants' Guild|trade consortium]] that advocated for [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] rights and supported the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] reconstruction effort. In reality, the Migrant Merchants' Guild was a highly organized crime syndicate that seized power during the [[riot]]s in the [[Old Galactic Market]] after the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
Even before the war's end, the guild served as a front for money laundering and goods smuggling, but kept mostly to nonviolent crime. Its membership was primarily nonhuman, and represented a powerful economic force inside Coruscant's nonhuman immigrant population. The Migrant Merchants' Guild expanded into bribery and extortion, with the Old Galactic Market as its [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters|headquarters]], all the while keeping a thin veneer of respectability. [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] patrols often clashed with members of the Migrant Merchants' Guild in an attempt to keep the peace, and had, at the zenith of its power, begun applying its influence less towards shaking down local businesses and more towards interfering in planetary politics.<ref name="SWTORcodex" />

The Guild was decimated by the death of [[Abiss Sol'oras]] and many of its members as well as the Coruscant Security crackdown following the [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|Migrant Merchants' Guild armed insurrection]]. Even so, the more civilian aspects of the Guild remained unopposed, such as the vendors [[Veor]], [[Veedo]], [[Qoussk]], [[Geeda (Coruscant)|Geeda]], and [[Grund'messel]] that wore their Guild armor openly while offering to sell goods such as armor and weapons to passersby in the peaceful parts of the [[Old Galactic Market]], whereas the vendor [[Edvaalda]] did the same in the [[Dealer's Den]] cantina. The guild leader [[Prakkath]] remained at large and vowed that the guild would get what it wanted out of the illicit deal it had with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vanara Kayl]].<ref name="SWTORCiGC" />
